Expanding on the Gold SCM capabilities with predictive optimizations requires significantly more details regarding EV operations. These details include an accurate (in this case perfect) forecast of when each of the vehicles will be dropped off at the RCC after a rental, their return SOC, and their expected dwell time before the next rental pickup. In addition to fleet operations, this strategy assumes an accurate forecast of facility loads and PV generation. Using this information, the controller will calculate the EVSE set points and net grid demand target in advance.
